Article 7 (Emergency Measures for Military Purposes)
(1) Where urgent measures are necessary for military purposes or in the event of a disaster, the Division Commander may temporarily command and supervise units within the division's area of jurisdiction other than units under command (hereinafter referred to as "other units").
(2) Where the Division Commander temporarily commands and supervises other units under paragraph (1), the Division Commander shall report the circumstances without delay to the immediate superior and notify the superior commanders of those other units.
